forecast_challenge: 5.84% is arithmetically consistent with the four OpenAI-iteration branches and DeepSeek conditional first shares 8/5/3.5/8%; weights/marginals sum to one. The weights and conditionals are judgment, not fitted winner frequencies or admission hazards.

Evidence binds weakly to Dec31: raw-route snapshot Oct15/retrieved Oct19; StyleControl OFF is frozen, but UI default is unexposed and raw route returned403. Preliminary ratings/vote CIs are not head-to-head winner probabilities; 416 models/8.83m votes are not independent competitors; unrounded ties/model ownership are unavailable.

Main uncertainties: source/config/fallback, text-model admission and release timing, challenger quality, rival response. Useful falsifiers: source-verified style-off Text board snapshots showing admitted DeepSeek rank/score persistence; historical admission-to-rank transitions on the same endpoint. A different Dec31 board/settings or changed fallback could falsify the mapping.

20pp reserve (10 release/quality/timing +5 source/config/rank +5 fills) is a scenario allowance, not an interval. Philosophy’s 10pp instance default derives from five historical revisions (all downward, 6–23pp), explicitly small-N and not outcome-calibrated; this gives no empirical case to go below 10pp here. It does not establish 20pp as uniquely correct.
